target: QuickPLS v1.5.7 UI/UX launch-quality audit smoke

issues.title: Version/status mismatch
issues.evidence: Header evidence shows stale v1.5.3 text while package metadata has advanced beyond it.
issues.recommendation: Wire visible version/status from package/app metadata and add static drift check.

issues.title: Primary run action appears on every workspace
issues.evidence: The top Run button competes with Data, Model, Results, and Report tasks.
issues.recommendation: Make the global run action compact outside Setup/Run or make it contextual.

issues.title: Teal carries too many meanings
issues.evidence: Brand, active navigation, success, selected cards, and primary actions all use similar teal.
issues.recommendation: Separate brand/action/status palettes and reserve success green for validation.

issues.title: Bottom status bar is noisy
issues.evidence: Many chips and messages compete with the main workflow.
issues.recommendation: Group status by project/data/model/method and collapse low-priority chips.

issues.title: Nested scrollbars feel heavy
issues.evidence: Data, Results, and Report show page scroll plus component/table scrolls.
issues.recommendation: Define a scroll ownership rule for each workspace.

issues.title: Cards have weak hierarchy
issues.evidence: Most cards share the same border/fill/weight regardless of importance.
issues.recommendation: Create primary, secondary, warning, and table-section card variants.

issues.title: Desktop density is inconsistent
issues.evidence: Some areas are sparse while tables and toolbars are crowded.
issues.recommendation: Standardize page gutters, section spacing, and row density tokens.

issues.title: Stepper and rail duplicate progress
issues.evidence: The workflow strip repeats the left rail and sometimes does not add actionable state.
issues.recommendation: Convert strip into a compact project-readiness ribbon or remove on dense workspaces.

issues.title: Icon style is not fully unified
issues.evidence: Some icons feel heavier or less aligned than adjacent labels.
issues.recommendation: Audit icon size/stroke and align all icon buttons to one token.

issues.title: Accessibility cannot be inferred from screenshots
issues.evidence: Keyboard/focus/contrast states are not visually documented for launch QA.
issues.recommendation: Add a launch accessibility smoke covering focus order, table navigation, and contrast.

issues.title: Home feels static and underpowered
issues.evidence: The current launcher looks clean but does not feel like a mature recent-project hub.
issues.recommendation: Add true recent projects, recovery status, and last-run summary.

issues.title: Home workflow cards duplicate navigation
issues.evidence: Data/Model/Run/Report cards repeat rail steps without much extra context.
issues.recommendation: Make cards contextual to the current project state or remove redundant ones.

issues.title: Large unused middle/right area
issues.evidence: The screen has substantial empty space at desktop size.
issues.recommendation: Use a two-column launcher: primary actions left, project/recent/evidence right.

issues.title: Continue recent project is not genuinely recent
issues.evidence: The card says use Open rather than listing actual projects.
issues.recommendation: Replace with real recent project cards or hide when unavailable.

issues.title: Current workspace save message is understated
issues.evidence: Autosave/recovery is important but the card reads like a passive notice.
issues.recommendation: Use a clearer project state panel with Save as primary when unsaved.

issues.title: Import source is visually larger than the data itself
issues.evidence: The import area dominates even after data exists.
issues.recommendation: Collapse import source after successful import and make the grid dominant.

issues.title: Data grid lacks mature desktop controls
issues.evidence: No visible column resize, sorting, freeze options, or compact mode controls.
issues.recommendation: Add resize/sort/freeze/density controls and stronger selected-column state.

issues.title: Data quality cards are not actionable enough
issues.evidence: Warnings do not clearly lead to Setup/Run consequences.
issues.recommendation: Add action links from each card to metadata, setup, or issue detail.

issues.title: Prefix chips look technical
issues.evidence: COMP -> 3 indicators is useful but visually raw.
issues.recommendation: Show construct-name preview with indicator count and confidence.

issues.title: Metadata panel can overtake inspection work
issues.evidence: Right panel consumes width even when the user only wants data review.
issues.recommendation: Allow collapsing metadata and keep column profile as a drawer.

issues.title: Browser/desktop import copy is too implementation-oriented
issues.evidence: Researchers should not need to think about browser preview versus desktop commands.
issues.recommendation: Use user-centered copy focused on file formats and saved project state.

issues.title: Context toolbar is crowded
issues.evidence: Selected construct toolbar exposes too many small actions in one line.
issues.recommendation: Keep Rename/Delete/Tidy visible and move side/pin/advanced actions into menus.

issues.title: Diagram labels remain fragile
issues.evidence: Some path/loading labels are tiny and can collide with lines or constructs.
issues.recommendation: Add label collision rules and bigger readable label tokens.

issues.title: Left explorer construct cards are too dense
issues.evidence: Cards combine counts, icons, side controls, and status in a compact block.
issues.recommendation: Use row-based construct list with hover/context actions.

issues.title: Right inspector duplicates canvas/sidebar controls
issues.evidence: Inspector repeats actions already visible in context toolbar and explorer.
issues.recommendation: Make inspector primarily properties/results; move common actions to context menus.

issues.title: Mini-map feels decorative
issues.evidence: It takes space but gives little readable navigation value.
issues.recommendation: Replace with useful overview/focus controls or hide by default.

issues.title: Canvas width is constrained by two side panels
issues.evidence: SEM diagram is central but gets less width than needed.
issues.recommendation: Add one-click collapse and remember panel state.

issues.title: Result overlay banner is redundant after visible values
issues.evidence: The banner consumes canvas space while the diagram already shows overlays.
issues.recommendation: Replace with compact overlay status in toolbar.

issues.title: Readiness cards still feel too card-heavy
issues.evidence: Six cards create a dashboard feel where a checklist would be faster.
issues.recommendation: Use compact readiness checklist with expandable details.

issues.title: Method presets do not show what changes
issues.evidence: Preset cards are blank and do not expose settings delta or output implications.
issues.recommendation: Make presets selectable cards with expected outputs and setting changes.

issues.title: Advanced methods are visible too early
issues.evidence: MICOM/MGA/CB-SEM/NCA compete with standard PLS setup.
issues.recommendation: Place advanced families in Expert accordion groups.

issues.title: Bootstrap checkbox feels unfinished
issues.evidence: The control is isolated and not styled as a clear setting row.
issues.recommendation: Use a toggle row with sample count and inference consequence.

issues.title: Lower method table is too far down
issues.evidence: Users must scroll to see method status list and settings.
issues.recommendation: Use split layout: method selection left, readiness/details right.

issues.title: Validated scope language needs hierarchy
issues.evidence: Validated badges appear, but exact support boundaries are not always near settings.
issues.recommendation: Add scope details inline for the selected method only.

issues.title: Run page repeats Setup readiness
issues.evidence: The screen repeats readiness cards instead of focusing on execution.
issues.recommendation: Compress readiness to a top checklist and expand only failures.

issues.title: Top global Run and page Run compete
issues.evidence: Two run actions are visible for the same outcome.
issues.recommendation: One primary action per screen; global action becomes shortcut only.

issues.title: Post-run guidance is generic
issues.evidence: After completion, Before publication, Next step cards do not adapt deeply to run state.
issues.recommendation: Use result-aware next steps after a completed run.

issues.title: Run screen is sparse at 1920px
issues.evidence: Cards span large space without enough useful detail.
issues.recommendation: Add compact execution summary, output preview, and provenance.

issues.title: Results tab block wraps awkwardly
issues.evidence: Tabs form a grid and consume too much space before results.
issues.recommendation: Use a left section list or compact horizontal tabs with overflow menu.

issues.title: Tables are hard to scan
issues.evidence: Wide tables, wrapped labels, and nested scrolling hurt readability.
issues.recommendation: Build a reusable research table shell with sticky headers, column groups, density, and horizontal affordances.

issues.title: Findings are too many and repetitive
issues.evidence: HTMT and mirrored construct pairs create repeated issue cards.
issues.recommendation: Deduplicate symmetrical findings and cap visible cards by priority.

issues.title: Issue cards dominate the page
issues.evidence: Findings push numerical tables down and overload users visually.
issues.recommendation: Summarize findings in Must address / Review / Info lanes with expandable details.

issues.title: Mediation table is especially difficult
issues.evidence: Important columns overflow and class text wraps awkwardly.
issues.recommendation: Split mediation into direct/indirect/total, inference, and classification subtables.

issues.title: Controls are crowded and misaligned
issues.evidence: Search, copy, export, precision, validated-only, interpretation, compact sit in one row.
issues.recommendation: Group table tools into toolbar sections and menus.

issues.title: Interpretation hierarchy needs stronger triage
issues.evidence: Current findings are value-specific but not yet a clear reporting checklist.
issues.recommendation: Make Interpretation tab the canonical report-readiness checklist.

issues.title: Result summary cards are useful but plain
issues.evidence: Strongest R2, Paths, Warnings cards lack interaction and visual ranking.
issues.recommendation: Make summary cards clickable filters into relevant sections.

issues.title: Scope warning line is low contrast and repetitive
issues.evidence: The validated-scope sentence appears in many places.
issues.recommendation: Use a single run-level scope chip with expandable details.

issues.title: Publication diagram still has label overlap
issues.evidence: Customer Satisfaction label/values collide in the preview.
issues.recommendation: Apply export label-collision rules and preview fail warnings.

issues.title: Publication preview uses nested scrolling
issues.evidence: The preview scrolls inside the page, making export review awkward.
issues.recommendation: Use fixed preview frame with fit-to-width/fit-page controls.

issues.title: Export cards look passive
issues.evidence: CSV/HTML/XLSX/PDF cards at the bottom do not clearly behave as actions.
issues.recommendation: Convert to explicit export buttons with disabled reasons and output destination feedback.

issues.title: Report controls are scattered
issues.evidence: Precision, palette, layout, loadings, path coefficients, R2, interpretation notes are spatially dispersed.
issues.recommendation: Group controls into Figure, Statistics, Tables, and Notes sections.

issues.title: Run comparison appears in Report without clear purpose
issues.evidence: Comparison table is useful but seems misplaced below export cards.
issues.recommendation: Move comparison to Results Comparison and only link summary from Report.

issues.title: PDF wording reads like limitation text
issues.evidence: Browser print-to-PDF is described, but the flow is not guided.
issues.recommendation: Provide a visible Print/PDF instruction action or keep it as documentation only.

issues.title: Contrast of subtle text may be weak
issues.evidence: Light blue/grey backgrounds with small text could fail for some users.
issues.recommendation: Run contrast audit and increase secondary text contrast.

issues.title: Icon-only actions need visible labels or robust tooltips
issues.evidence: Model explorer has several unlabeled icon actions.
issues.recommendation: Ensure accessible names, tooltips, and contextual labels for every icon action.

issues.title: Keyboard table navigation is not visible from screenshots
issues.evidence: Launch readiness requires proving keyboard traversal and focus states.
issues.recommendation: Add keyboard smoke for result/data table search, row focus, and copy/export.

issues.title: Large model interaction quality remains unproven visually
issues.evidence: Screens show small sample model only.
issues.recommendation: Add large-model visual QA after redesign: 8/32 and 20/80 models.

issues.title: No obvious token audit artifact
issues.evidence: The UI appears to have accumulated local styles over time.
issues.recommendation: Create token inventory and forbid one-off card/table/status styling.

issues.title: No single launch-grade visual acceptance checklist
issues.evidence: Prior gates prove slices, not final visual quality across all screens.
issues.recommendation: Create a launch UI QA checklist with required screenshots and pass/fail criteria.

issues.title: Next milestones need dependency order
issues.evidence: Random fixes could create churn.
issues.recommendation: Sequence work as shell/design-system, Results, Report, Model, Setup/Run, Data/Home.
